    get_theorem_by_name("list_RECURSION"),
    `(cm_patch_tail ([]:(tvm_inst)list) == ([]:(tvm_inst)list)) /\
     (!(head:tvm_inst) (rest:(tvm_inst)list).
        cm_patch_tail (head :: rest) == rest)`);
